instruction:
Use the Abaqus/CAE GUI to perform a torsion analysis of a circular shaft (Variant B):

1. Part: 3D Deformable Solid, Revolution
   - Sketch in the X-Y plane: draw a rectangle from (0,0) to (6,72)
   - The left vertical edge at X=0 is the revolution axis (global Y-axis)
   - Revolve 360 deg to create a solid cylinder with diameter 12 mm and length 72 mm, aligned with the global Y-axis

2. Property:
   - Material Steel: E = 210000 MPa, nu = 0.3
   - Solid Homogeneous section

3. Assembly: Create an instance.

4. Step: Static, General, named Step-Torque-B.

5. Interaction:
   - Create a Reference Point (RP-1) at the center of the free end face (Y=72 mm, X=0, Z=0)
   - Use Constraint > Coupling to kinematically couple the free end face and RP-1 (all 6 DOFs)
   - Apply Encastre to the fixed end face (Y=0)

6. Load:
   - Apply a torque (Moment) = 920 N*mm at RP-1 about the shaft axis (global Y-axis, i.e., component MY)

7. Mesh:
   - Global seed size: 4 mm
   - Element type: C3D8R

8. Job: Create Job-Torsion-B and submit for solving.

9. Visualization:
   - Review Mises stress contour
   - Query RP-1 rotation magnitude (UR)
   - Query shear stress components at any node on the shaft outer surface (radius ≈ 6 mm)

10. Save:
    - Model: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Torsion-B.cae
    - Results: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Torsion-B.odb
